text:
lia: Heads up: on 2026-05-12 we'll change billing aggregation to hourly rollups for invoice line items and public CSVs. This is to declutter invoices for bursty apps and improve downstream reconciliation. Enforcement stays per-minute.

sam: Will this affect how free trial credits are consumed? We shouldn't shorten trial periods.

lia: Good catch. We're introducing a credit-protection layer ("smoothing") so trial/free credits are accounted to approximate prior per-request consumption. Details in RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfc/hourly-billing-protections

finance-bot: Summary from RFC: 1) invoice aggregation window = 1 hour; 2) trial credits protected via smoothing and floor rules; 3) 90-day minute-export available on request for audits; 4) partner notification + console toggle planned.

billing-team: We'll review any contractual language that references minute-level invoice rows and propose amendment copy if needed.

support: Need a support playbook and an FAQ for customers asking why their CSVs look different. Also request opt-in minute CSV for investigations.

infra: Pipeline note: we'll run side-by-side simulation starting 2026-04-20. Backfills will use a separate queue to avoid dashboard spikes.

lia: Action items: billing-team and legal to sign off by 2026-04-15; infra to run 3-week simulation; support/comms to draft customer email + FAQ. We'll add a 14-day console rollback toggle post-cutover. I'll post simulation results in this thread. Thanks. :thumbsup:
